channel.title: San Mateo Dispatch
channel.description: San Mateo and Burlingame news, once a week, from the San Mateo Dispatch.

item.title: No left turns on El Camino Real between Hillside Drive and Lincoln Avenue through December
item.description: Caltrans' $173 million El Camino Real Roadway Renewal runs through Burlingame and touches Hillsborough, San Mateo and Millbrae, from 2026 to 2029.

item.title: The county is getting ready for a strong El Niño winter, and sandbags are free now
item.description: California declared a statewide El Niño emergency on September 21, and NOAA gives an 83% chance this will be the strongest El Niño since 1950.

item.title: A traffic signal for Hillsdale Boulevard and Alameda de las Pulgas is out to bid
item.description: San Mateo advertised the construction contract in October and has an apparent low bidder; staff expects to bring the award to the City Council by the end of 2026, with construction set for summer 2027.

item.title: adopt a storm drain
item.description: Leaves are what block a storm drain first, and a blocked drain is how a rainy night puts water across the street.
